title: Addendum to export2: (2,4,4,2)-class boxes beyond the ring wrongly omitted from export2
reason: export2 treated pass-1 leftovers as closed in shards whose pass-2 rerun was restricted to shoulder rows; these rows were unresolved by frontier pass 1 and were never accepted by any later source
conventions: identical to export2 (exact rational binary64 centres in [-pi,pi]; radius(level) outward bound of pi/2^level + 2^-40)
